# UC-376 — View the Append-Only Timeline for an Own Sub-Order

## Header Info
- **Use Case ID:** UC-376
- **Title:** View the Append-Only Timeline for an Own Sub-Order
- **Actor:** Vendor (ACT-02) — any own-store staff role
- **Trigger:** The vendor opens the status history of one of their sub-orders
- **Priority:** P2
- **Goal:** Reconstruct who moved the sub-order, when and why, from an immutable history the vendor can trust.
- **Preconditions:** Own sub-order exists (BR-VND-07); status-history rows exist for at least one transition; store readable.

## Main Scenario
1. Vendor opens the sub-order → client `GET /store/orders/{id}` embeds the timeline slice (API-ORD-007).
2. Vendor opens the full timeline → client `GET /orders/{id}/timeline` returns entries `{ subOrderId, from, to, actorRole, actorName?, reason?, at }` (API-ORD-005).
3. Entries are filtered to the caller's visibility slice — the vendor receives own sub-order rows only (BR-ORD-09).
4. The timeline is strictly read-only: states are never overwritten and no editing path exists (BR-ORD-03).
5. Vendor reads the trail to attribute each change (accept, fulfilment, cancellation, dispute) to its actor and reason.

## Alternative Scenarios
- **A1 — Multi-vendor master order:** only this store's sub-order rows are returned; other vendors' rows never appear (BR-ORD-09, BR-VND-07).
- **A2 — Entries from other actors:** Admin overrides, disputes and returns appear with their `actorRole`; visibility is unaffected, editability never changes (BR-ORD-03).
- **A3 — After suspension or release:** history survives status changes intact because rows are appended, never rewritten (BR-ORD-03).

## Exception Scenarios
- **E1 — Foreign sub-order or unknown id:** → 404 `NOT_FOUND` (BR-VND-07).
- **E2 — Row outside the caller's slice:** → 403 `TIMELINE_ACCESS_DENIED` instead of another party's data (BR-ORD-09).
- **E3 — Store suspended:** store-scoped reads are refused with `STORE_SUSPENDED` until release (BR-VND-04).

## Postconditions
- A read-only snapshot of the committed history rows is returned; nothing is written by this use case.
- Order state, version and escrow are untouched (BR-ORD-03).

## Business Rules Applied
- BR-ORD-03, BR-ORD-09, BR-VND-04, BR-VND-07

## Related Requirements
- FR-012 (Order Lifecycle Management)

## Permissions / Data / External Dependencies
- **Permissions:** own sub-orders only (BR-ORD-09); couriers and Admins read their own separately scoped slices (DOC-OVR-007).
- **Data involved:** `order_status_history` (read), sub-order projection.
- **External dependencies:** none — a direct read of the B06 order store; responses are `no-store`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- **AC-UC376-01:** Given an own sub-order, when the timeline is opened, then every transition appears with actor, timestamp and reason (BR-ORD-03).
- **AC-UC376-02:** Given another vendor's sub-order, when requested, then 404 `NOT_FOUND` is returned (BR-VND-07).
- **AC-UC376-03:** Given an entry outside the caller's visibility slice, when requested, then `TIMELINE_ACCESS_DENIED` is returned (BR-ORD-09).
- **AC-UC376-04:** Given the same sub-order read twice, when compared, then both reads return the identical append-only entry list (BR-ORD-03).
